subject.title: fix(skills): pass ownerHandle in ClawHub bulk verdict targets to resolve ambiguous slugs

question: Should ambiguous owner-qualified verdicts wait for an owner-aware ClawHub bulk contract, or should OpenClaw introduce a bounded single-skill `/verify` fallback?
rationale: The existing feature deliberately avoids per-skill fallback requests, while the currently deployed and documented bulk contract does not consume the field added by this PR.

options.title: Coordinate the bulk contract
options.body: Add owner-qualified identity to ClawHub's bulk endpoint first, then merge the OpenClaw consumer with end-to-end proof.

options.title: Approve a bounded fallback
options.body: Permit OpenClaw to retry owner-qualified `skill_not_found` items through `/verify`, accepting the additional request and policy complexity.

recommendation.title: Coordinate the bulk contract
recommendation.body: Add owner-qualified identity to ClawHub's bulk endpoint first, then merge the OpenClaw consumer with end-to-end proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history shows ownership of the bulk-verdict architecture and its intentional fallback policy.
